ticks: zero-based completed control transitions, all event confirmation ticks explicit
firstphase: strictly before recorded after.successes first reaches1; native confirmation transition excluded
gate: recorded native_keypoints_max_dist<=0.015m; recorded cumulative near counter retained; native force_consecutive=false unchanged
premature_geometry: while firstphase and recorded cumulative counter<10, fixed final-pose keypoint<=7.5mm AND mean fingertip-object-root distance>100mm for10 consecutive transitions; diagnostic only; strict native success unchanged
stable_reference: last frame with>=2 force-contact fingers in BOTH physics substeps before first gate; if nevergate use closest firstphase approach and label it separately
relative_motion: >=5mm translation OR>=5deg relative object-palm angle from reference for3ticks; not automatically accidental slip
descent: 10mm net world-Z decrease between t-12 and t, reported separately for object,palm,and FK of final target_after_rad; firstphase afterstable and aftergate scopes separate
contactloss: all5 object force resultant magnitudes<0.1N in BOTH physics substeps for3ticks; afterstable and aftergate scopes separate
commands: actual final actuator target_after_rad; FK link iiwa14_link_7 in world via recorded base pose; recorded URDF SHA/root must match; measured FK error exported
native_open_command: UNKNOWN for all: no explicit task-native open-hand joint target identified; default/reset zero pose not assumed open; final command and actual hand joint vectors exported for inspection
train_scope: all180 raw episodes, physical student prefix and expert suffix both retained; dagger control_source/expert_label_valid/segment_id exported where available; absent mask remains blank
missing: unknown; blank absent optional column; rolling-window first12 rows NaN means unavailable history, not false movement
